title: CounterFactual Retrieval (CFR)
description:
Code for CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification, accepted at WACV 2027. The repository provides CFR and SSI metrics and an evaluation framework for evidence-aware animal re-identification. The evaluation compares full, foreground, background, and silhouette views to assess the evidence used for individual identification. It includes retrieval and robustness evaluation scripts, experiment configurations, and supporting mask-generation and download tools.

Foreground masks are available separately at CFR Wildlife Masks. Source images and model weights are obtained separately.
